sections.title: Fixed
items: Safer battle map downloads. When a battle needs a map you don't have yet, the game now checks that the map really comes from our server before it installs it. A fake or changed map is refused, and nothing is written to your game folder.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: The DEV test build is now version 1.1.0. Update once through Warlords.exe to keep joining the servers.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: The lobby now shows the StratLords name in the top-left corner and on the top menu tab.
Access to the DEV test servers no longer runs out after a day. Update once through Warlords.exe and you stay able to join.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Maintenance only: removed private developer computer details from a battle map data file. Nothing changes in game.

sections.title: New
items: Campaign battles and sieges now give Warlords gold, the same amounts as deathmatch: kills, assists, first blood, kill streaks, killing horses, damage dealt, time in the fight and a reward at the end (more for the winners). Killing a teammate costs gold, like in deathmatch.
Your campaign army gear, lives and results work the same as before. Campaign battles give no loot, quests or prestige.
This turns on once the campaign servers are updated. It has not been tried in a real game yet.

sections.title: New
items: Prepares campaign road battles to use their own generated battle map, checked by the server before the battle opens. If a map fails the check, the battle falls back to its normal map.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: DEV testers get a Siege server ("Dev Warlords Siege", 250 players) and two more Clan Battle servers (100 players each).
The DEV lobby now holds up to 1000 players and the DEV battle server up to 100.
These have not been tried in a real game yet.
DEV testers get a Clan Battle server ("Dev Warlords Clan Battle") next to the DEV lobby and battle server. It shows under Clan Wars. This has not been tried in a real game yet.
DEV testers can now be let into campaign field battles and sieges, not only the DEV lobby and battle server. This has not been tried in a real game yet.

sections.title: Disabled
items: Generated campaign battle maps are not switched on yet; battles still use their usual maps for now.

sections.title: Fixed
items: In DEV map trials, an old copy of a battle map is now replaced with the server's version before joining, so you no longer fall from the sky or see flags inside the ground.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: DEV map trials can now use maps generated for real places on the campaign map, each with its own name.

sections.title: New
items: In DEV map trials, clicking Join now downloads a missing battle map first, shows its progress, and then joins.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Joining a DEV map trial without its map no longer crashes the game.

sections.title: New
items: Added DEV groundwork for inspecting generated woodland, highland and river battlefields with separate map downloads. These trials are not enabled for normal campaign battles.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Improved checks that prevent a private map trial from opening with missing or mismatched terrain and spawn data.
